audit_type: wave-2 still-missing gap audit: post-fill regional-skilling-unlocks vs high-value permanent skilling unlocks
compared_against: scraped-data/audit-ironman-unlocks-vs-app-2026-07-26.json (stale on several rows — re-checked against current file)

policy.present_count: Records in regional-skilling-unlocks.json whose regionHints include the region (multi-region rows count in every listed region).
policy.missing_rule: HIGH-VALUE only: permanent tools, outfits, shops, relics, diaries, production infrastructure, region-defining hubs, or ironman-essential permanent unlocks that materially change no-trade skilling. Training methods / XP rates alone excluded. Combat-only unlocks excluded unless they are primarily skilling infrastructure or multi-skill permanents (e.g. toolbelt attaches, Slayer helmet as permanent multi-style unlock).
policy.first_class_rule: Buried inside a hub blurb or cross-region stack note does NOT count as present. Planner-visible id required.
policy.harshness: Wave-1 catastrophic empties (Karamja 0, Havenhythe 1, Desert without Menaphos) are FIXED. Wave-2 critique targets residual blind spots, diary incompleteness, over-splitting, and ironman essentials still only in footnotes.
policy.stale_audit_note: audit-ironman-unlocks-vs-app-2026-07-26.json still marks many items in_app:false that ARE now present (Underworld Grimoire, Diviner's outfit, Always Adze, Light Form, cooking/smelting gauntlets, plank box, Ranger's Workroom, elder divination outfit, ethereal outfits, Ring of Whispers, Death Note, pontifex ring, Varrock armour, shark/fury shark outfit row). Do not trust that file's in_app flags without re-grep.

summary.verdict: Quantity explosion fixed the worst geographic holes. Quality is uneven: hub coverage is good; diary/toolbelt/outfit completeness and stack-linking are still planner-hostile. ~25–35% of rows are duplicates, pointers, hygiene anti-rows, removed-content notices, or over-granular spell/building splits of a single system.

top_30_still_missing.name: Slayer helmet craft + full upgrade chain
top_30_still_missing.why_still_missing: Ironman Slayer #1 essential permanent. 400-point craft after Smoking Kills; full/reinforced/corrupted/fused upgrades. Part farms (black mask, focus sight, hexcrest, spectral lens) are multi-region. Zero first-class skilling/combat-adjacent permanent unlock row. Mandrith/Wilderness Slayer hub does not substitute.

top_30_still_missing.why_still_missing: Items exist as shop rows (bonecrusher, herbicide, charming imp, seedicide-named) but the permanent 500-point toolbelt-attach unlocks are not modeled. Planner cannot distinguish owning the item from owning the attach. Gold accumulator has no row at all.

over_engineered_or_duplicate_warnings.problem: Daemonheim rewards exploded into generic bundle + shop hub + ~15 named item rows. Valuable content, but the generic bundle still lists many of the same items — triple bookkeeping. Collapse generic bundle into shop hub + named permanents only; delete redundant unlock lists.
Two nearly identical cross-region stack records (orthen-superheat-autoheater vs orthen-furnace-core-stack) plus all three piece rows. Pick one stack id; link pieces. Dual stacks will desync notes.
Three Kandarin skillchompa rows (supply hub, equipment, hunter site). Merge to activity + optional equipment; stop triple-counting Kandarin skillchompa value.
Legacy thin artisans row retained beside full-rewards + burial + outfit + masterwork chain. The original asgarnia:artisans-workshop-rewards is supersession fodder.
FPF activity + herblore-outfits activity + two equipment rows. Acceptable if equipment is canonical, but herblore-outfits activity duplicates equipment effects — keep one activity + two equipment.
Pointer row is pure noise once herby-werby-herb-bag is first-class. Delete pointer.

Waterfall shop unlocks the rod; rod is also equipment. Fine as activity+equipment pair IF shop detail stops restating full rod effects and equipment stops restating full shop loop — currently dual narrative.

Workshop bundle + partial individual tools + dragon-base cross-region. Missing crystal pick/hatchet/mattock as equipment while hammer/tinderbox/rod exist — inconsistent granularity. Either expand all crystal tools or keep workshop-only.
Activity that unlocks black ibis + separate black-ibis equipment. Same pattern as FPF; collapse or hard-link.
First Age outfit appears as activity reward and equipment; ectofuntus worship is separate (good) but outfit double-file remains.

Four equipment rows for one diary ladder. Prefer one diary progression row with tier effects, or accept four only if every other region diary gets the same treatment (they do not — Asgarnia/Forinthry still missing entirely).
Family Crest activity/bundle plus both gauntlet equipment rows. Bundle is redundant if both equipment exist.

Lunar system over-split: spellbook hub + ~9 individual spells + Livid Farm. High-value spells deserve rows, but humidify/string jewellery/make leather could nest under lunar-farming-utility / spellbook to cut Fremennik bloat.

Fort exploded correctly for planner value, but woodcutters-grove + woodcutters-grove-facilities + imcando-hatchet is triple Grove coverage. Add a single fort-building-stack hub OR accept buildings and delete facilities duplicate.

Hygiene / boundary / removed-content / combat-pointer rows pollute the unlock index. Useful as research notes; harmful as planner unlocks. Move to a separate 'non-unlocks' or 'region-boundary-notes' file — counting them as skilling unlocks inflates totals and confuses region value.

RegionHints include anachronia but detail correctly says Warforge/Karamja owns the Seed of the Charyou Tree unlock. Mis-tagged primary region will mislead region scoring. Prefer karamja/forinthry primary + anachronia benefit note.
Kandarin Fishing cluster is five rows deep before Piscatoris. Hub + guild + methods is enough; methods row risks becoming a training-methods dump inside unlocks.
GOTE equipment + porter-chain cross-region is a justified pair (craft/energy vs finished necklace). Keep, but ensure chain does not restate full equipment effects.
seedicide-not-daemonheim is a hygiene anti-row; seedicide-named is the real unlock. Anti-row should not count toward forinthry unlock power.
